'''Visdic body wrappings''' were a [[Color/Legends|tan]] [[Clothing/Legends|garment]] worn by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Malé-Dee/Legends|Malé-Dee]]<ref name="Scrapbook" /> of [[Uyter/Legends|Uyter]], a native of the [[Visdic territories]] of which they shared their name.<ref name="DB" /> Malé-Dee wore these body wrappings<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> shortly after the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], when he and other dignitaries stood on a landing platform before [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]'s [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Executive Building]] to welcome [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] back from his [[Prison/Legends|captivity]] aboard the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] ''[[Invisible Hand/Legends|Invisible Hand]]''.<ref name="ROTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Visdic body wrappings were first mentioned by ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Scrapbook]]'' by [[Ryder Windham]]<ref name="Scrapbook" /> and ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]'' by [[James Luceno]],<ref name="ROTSVD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> released simultaneously on [[April 2]], [[2005]].<ref name="Scrapbook release date">{{Amazon|url=/Revenge-Sith-Scrapbook-Star-Wars/dp/0375826114|text=Revenge of the Sith Scrapbook (Star Wars)|archivedate=20160528170422}}</ref><ref name="ROTSVD release date">{{DK|url=us/9780756611286-star-wars-revenge-of-the-sith-the-visual-dictionary|text=Star Wars Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary|nolive=1}}</ref> The body wrappings would then make their appearance in the final film of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]], [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="ROTS" /> on [[May 19]] of that same year<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> in landing platform scenes shot at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[July 22]], 2003.<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref>
